[[File:Ramid_Twilek_pilot.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ramid's Twi'lek pilot]]
A '''[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]''' worked as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Ramid]]'s [[Ramid's starship|starship]] around [[139 ABY]]. The pilot had two [[Lekku/Legends|lekkus]] and [[Color/Legends|green]] skin. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the pilot took part in the kidnapping of [[Ania Solo]], Ramid's estranged former flame who was wanted by the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] for the murder of [[Teemen Alton]], an [[Imperial Knight]].<ref name="Legacy 11">[[Legacy (2013) 11|''Legacy'' (2013) 11]]</ref> Later, when Solo managed to overpower Ramid's [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Unidentified Klatooinian crew member|crew mate]], the pilot managed to restrain Ania by knocking her rod from her hand with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. Ramid then led Ania back to her cell.<ref name="Legacy 12">[[Legacy (2013) 12|''Legacy'' (2013) 12]]</ref>

Later, the Twi'lek pilot flew the starship to a remote star system. Running short of fuel, Ramid's crew decided to land on a small outpost on the fourth planet there, which rained acid and glass. While entering the planet's atmosphere, Ramid's starship was attacked by [[Unidentified masked bounty hunter|another bounty hunter]], who piloted a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]]. During the pursuit, the Twi'lek pilot was killed, forcing Ramid to summon his estranged former flame Ania for help.<ref name="Legacy 12" />
